segments.he:
תּוֹרָה קפט
עִקַּר נְשִׁיכַת הַנָּחָשׁ הוּא עַצְבוּת וְעַצְלוּת, עַל־כֵּן צָרִיךְ לִזָּהֵר מְאֹד מֵעַצְבוּת וְעַצְלוּת:
segments.en: One who hears a word from the mouth of the true Tzadik — and in particular when one sees him then — receives the aspect of the Tzadik's face and the aspect of his intellect and his soul. But one must guard oneself from forgetting. For forgetting causes all this to be forgotten from one. And when one merits to remembrance — to remember the Tzadik's words as he said them — or through repeating them a hundred and one times so that one remembers them — then when one says this matter in the name of the Tzadik — the form of the sage's image appears before one. And it is as if the Tzadik himself said it. But the remembrance must be genuine — through the power of true remembrance.
